kultivator.gui43.m01.harta.tetapkan.tip: Sit in meditation on the seat of a qi formation inside an active protective formation, then press this. That seat becomes your Cave Abode.
kultivator.gui43.m01.harta.hapus.tip: Gives up your Cave Abode. Its bonus stops until you set a new one.
kultivator.gui43.m01.harta.hapus.yakin: Remove your Cave Abode? Its bonus stops until you set a new one.
kultivator.gui43.m01.harta.cara: Meditate on the seat of a qi formation inside an active protective formation, then press "Set it here" (or /cultivate gua tetapkan). Within 6 blocks of that seat qi veins drain at half speed, enlightenment comes more often, and Destruction Mode never carves within 16 blocks.
kultivator.gui43.m01.pusaka.cincin.tip: Opens the highest bound storage ring in your bag. Esc brings you back to this page.
kultivator.gui43.m01.dao.sumpah: Swear by %s? A Dao oath lasts a lifetime and cannot be taken back.
